# Missing Sources
> A concept page that never says where it came from.

## What it is
The positive control for the required-heading half of the concept check. It has
an H1 and three of the four sections the [[SCHEMA]] template requires; the
`## Sources:` section is missing.

## How we use it (project-specific!)
As the one page in this fixture that yields a `concept-missing-heading` warn
and nothing else.
